output.summary: Ransomware detected on loan-processing servers in India and EU affecting ~192,000 customers; encrypted core database with ransom note demanding payment for stolen data release.

stepNotes.note: Isolate affected hosts LN-APP-02 and LN-DB01 from the network.
Disable compromised domain admin account svc_backup

extraSteps.text: Identify every affected host and the first infected machine (patient zero) using EDR; capture memory from at least one live infected host.
Verify backups are clean, then restore customer data in priority order starting with loan processing services.
Review privileged-access tiering and test backup restoration as a regular exercise.

techniques.id: T1048.003 Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol

suggestedFacts.key: personal_data_breach: Are we reasonably certain that personal data was accessed, stolen, altered or lost?
